checks.message: Provisional boundary is present and clearly labelled; replace with the official redline before professional scoring.
Three required key areas are provisional; replace with official polygons before professional scoring.
Blocks are polygonized from OSM arterial centrelines; residual space between blocks is assigned as road right-of-way, giving 100.00% coverage of the site boundary.
Static offline HTML with base64-embedded figures; no CDN, remote tiles, external fonts, scripts, fetch, iframe or form.
Proposal references standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions; every metric reference resolves in metrics.json.
OSM-derived features carry source_type=osm, geometry_role=existing_condition and ODbL attribution; query, bbox and osm_base timestamp are recorded in sources.json.
Connectivity diagnosis recomputed from the submitted roads.geojson in EPSG:4548; method and limitation recorded under breakdowns.connectivity_diagnosis.
